 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 Como make another change with just under 20 minutes remaining as Kaiki is replaced by Lucas da Cunha.
 80 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'That's a shock for me. It really is' published at 19:14 BST 19:14 BST 
 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 That's a shock for me. It really is.
 For me, Bruno Fernandes is better when he's playing deeper. Once he's faced up, and has runners off him, he can pick people out like the ball he played to Amad.
 He's not happy is he? Look, he's looking at the bench.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 203 60 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:13 BST 19:13 BST 
 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 Lovely ball into the box but Maxence Caqueret's first touch is a poor one and he can't keep the ball in play. Better control there and Como had a great chance to get a fourth.
 169 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:12 BST 19:12 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 To answer Ian’s question at 19:06 - “Ti licenziano domattina” - 2 years of Duolingo Italian finally pays off! 
Also, Nico Paz is a gem of a footballer. Proper bright future. United look absolutely lost.
 Paul, Manchester 
 679 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 19:11 BST 19:11 BST 
 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 Manchester United also make another change as Joshua Zirkzee is sent on for Bruno Fernandes, who has had another quiet night.
 372 99 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 19:09 BST 19:09 BST 
 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 Como make a change as Maxence Caqueret replaces Martin Baturina. 
 138 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'How much worse could things get?' published at 19:08 BST 19:08 BST 
 Como 3-0 Man Utd 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 We still have around half an hour to go so for the worry for United is how much worse things could get.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 Image source, Reuters 
 460 65 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:08 BST 19:08 BST 
 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 A rare decent moment for Manchester United as Bruno Fernandes lifts the ball into the box for Amad Diallo, but he is unable to connect. Had he got a touch there was a good chance the visitors would have got a goal back.
 Image source, Reuters 
 100 260 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:06 BST 19:06 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 What's the Italian for "you're getting sacked in the morning"?
 Ian, Hinckley 
 1841 172 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'So clinical' from Paz published at 19:05 BST 19:05 BST 
 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 So clinical.
 Baleba trying to get the ball round the corner with no support, and behind him is Paz.
 De Ligt has a problem straight away. As soon as he sees it happen does he come across? If he comes across Paz will slide the striker in that [De Ligt] is marking.
 Paz keeps his head, has a glance, opens his body up. No defender on sight. He's had a super, super game.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 493 58 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:03 BST 19:03 BST 
 Como 3-0 Manchester United 
 Manchester United can't get the ball off Como now as Nico Paz goes for the hat-trick with a lofted strike from the edge of the box, but Senne Lammens saves.
 521 91 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:02 BST 19:02 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 If I were Carrick I would walk in the morning. He did the best he could, however the same happens time and time again. The players are just not giving their all and that is the biggest problem with every manager.
 Jason, Dublin 
 2541 226 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Como 3-0 Manchester United published at 19:00 BST 19:00 BST 
 Nico Paz 
 Wow!
 It gets worse for Manchester United, where is the defending again!?
 Carlos Baleba gives the ball away to Nico Paz near the halfway line and Paz charges into the box. No-one is able to get close to him before he drives a shot into the back of the net.
 What a night for Como, they are 3-0 up and fully deserve to be as well. By far the better side.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 3433 530 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:58 BST 18:58 BST 
 Como 2-0 Manchester United 
 The Manchester United defence is once again exposed as Harry Maguire fails to close down Lucas da Cunha, who tries to bend a shot into the far corner but the ball goes over.
 500 146 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's just a fantastic goal' published at 18:57 BST 18:57 BST 
 Como 2-0 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 It's just a fantastic goal, it really is. United have come out with more intent, looking as if they want to get on the front foot but sadly just a couple of little turns and passes, and my word, they are in behind United.
 Great little run from Douvikas, he goes on the blind side of de Ligt, and shoots across the front of him.
 578 113 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:56 BST 18:56 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Utterly ridiculous. Why can't United be organised at the start of halves? May as well throw the kids on now; what's there to lose!?
 Andrew, Corinth TX 
 1311 112 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:56 BST 18:56 BST 
 Como 2-0 Manchester United 
 Mason Mount tries his luck from way out but the shot is always rising. It looked like a shot taken in frustration. 
 235 85 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Where is the United defence?' published at 18:55 BST 18:55 BST 
 Como 2-0 Man Utd 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 Where is the United defence? They are opened up again, and no-one gets across.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 500 96 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Como 2-0 Manchester United published at 18:53 BST 18:53 BST 
 Tasos Douvikas (48 mins) 
 Three minutes into the second half...
 Manchester United had actually started the second half with more intensity but they are caught out as Nico Paz plays a neat ball to Tasos Douvikas and he thumps a powerful strike into the back of the net.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 2502 638 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Team news - Kane starts for Bayern, Madueke in for Eze for Arsenal published at 18:51 BST 18:51 BST 
 Bayern Munich v Arsneal (20:00 BST) 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport Arsenal reporter at the Allianz Arena 
 Harry Kane leads the line as expected for Bayern with winger Luis Diaz on the bench for the home side. 
 Bayern Munich starting XI: Neuer, Stanisic, Kim Minjae, Upamecano, Davies, Pavlovic, Laimer, Bischof, Gnabry, Saibari, Kane 
 Substitutes: UIreich, Urbig, Ito, Tah, Brown, Luis Diaz, Boey, Sapoko Ndiaye, Karl, Binder
 Mikel Arteta makes two changes to the side that beat Nottingham Forest at the weekend. Noni Madueke who scored the winning goal comes in for Eberechi Eze while Jurrien Timber replaces Ben White. 
 Arsenal starting XI: Raya, Timber, Konsa, Gabriel, Calafiori, Rice, Guimaraes, Odegaard, Madueke, Saka, Havertz 
 Substitutes: Arrizabalaga, Meslier, Mosquera, Lewis-Skelly, White, Zubimendi, Merino, Eze, Gyokeres
